title: Sparse Attention for Very Long Placeholder Documents
summary: We study sparse attention patterns on synthetic long documents and show a 4x memory reduction with no loss in placeholder accuracy.
aiSummary: Sparse attention cuts memory 4x on long documents.

title: A Benchmark of Imaginary Reasoning Tasks
summary: We introduce a benchmark of 1,000 made-up reasoning tasks and evaluate a dozen fictional models on it.

title: Training Small Models on Dummy Data
summary: This paper shows that small models trained only on dummy data learn surprisingly little, as expected.
aiSummary: Small models learn little from dummy data.

title: Diffusion Models for Generating Test Fixtures
summary: We apply diffusion models to generate realistic-looking but entirely fake test fixtures for web applications.
aiSummary: Diffusion models can generate fake test fixtures.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Lorem Ipsum
summary: We evaluate retrieval-augmented generation on a corpus made entirely of lorem ipsum text.

title: Scaling Laws for Placeholder Text
summary: We fit scaling laws to models trained on increasing amounts of placeholder text and find a familiar power law.
aiSummary: Placeholder text follows familiar scaling laws.
